footnoteDefinitions.1: This agency provides services under a federal waiver program to non-traditional, chronic long term population.
footnoteDefinitions.10: Survey results are based on less than 12 months of data.
footnoteDefinitions.11: Fewer than 70 patients completed the survey. Use the scores shown, if any, with caution as the number of surveys may be too low to accurately tell how an agency is doing.
footnoteDefinitions.12: No survey results are available for this period.
footnoteDefinitions.13: Data suppressed by CMS for one or more quarters.
footnoteDefinitions.2: This agency provides services to a special needs population.
footnoteDefinitions.4: The number of patient episodes for this measure is too small to report.
footnoteDefinitions.5: This measure currently does not have data or provider has been certified/recertified for less than 6 months.
footnoteDefinitions.6: The national average for this measure is not provided because of state-to-state differences in data collection.
footnoteDefinitions.7: Medicare is not displaying rates for this measure for any home health agency, because of an issue with the data.
footnoteDefinitions.8: There were problems with the data and they are being corrected.
footnoteDefinitions.9: Zero, or very few, patients met the survey's rules for inclusion. The scores shown, if any, reflect a very small number of surveys and may not accurately tell how an agency is doing.

interpretationRules: Clinical measures, HHCAHPS patient experience, certification, and consumer reviews have separate meanings.
Missing or suppressed values remain null with original markers and footnotes, never zero.
Clinical denominators are the published counts for that measure. No HHCAHPS item denominator is inferred from completed surveys.
Reported service ZIPs are not office county, countywide service, current acceptance, or availability.
Footnote definitions are transcribed from retained HHS Data Dictionary version 14.0, Table 14, page 47. Codes 14 through 16 apply only to HHVBP and are not used here.
